name: Example
_insecureTLS: Bahut si .gov.in / .nic.in sites ka SSL cert expired ya chain-incomplete hota hai. Ye true karne se wo error skip ho jayega.
_selector: Optional. Diya to sirf isi ke andar ke <a> harvest honge. Nahi diya to pure page ke links. Shuru me mat do -- pehle --discover chala ke dekho.
_include: Optional regex. Link text isse match karna hi chahiye.
_exclude: Optional regex. Match hua to link drop.
_forceType: Classifier ko override karo: job | admit_card | result | answer_key
_requireYear: true = link text ya URL me current/previous year hona chahiye. Purani archive news filter karne ke liye.
